title: AEMS: Autonomous Energy Monitoring System
description: Open-source hardware, firmware, and host software for the Autonomous Energy Monitoring System (AEMS): a low-cost, modular platform for high-resolution energy monitoring of manufacturing equipment. Includes the AEMS v2 board design (KiCad), STM32H745 dual-core firmware, and a Python host stack with Raspberry Pi daemon and optional AWS IoT cloud agent. Licensing: hardware under CERN-OHL-P-2.0, firmware and software under MIT, documentation under CC-BY-4.0.
